name: Manim Community
purpose: Python math-animation engine (LaTeX equations, equation-to-equation morphs, function plots). Candidate plate engine for equation transforms that SVG + GSAP cannot carry; not installed.

installation.instructions: Not installed. Would need a LaTeX distribution (gigabytes) and a third plate pipeline; decide per brief through workspace-steward and dependency-intake-check.

compatibility.notes: Renders mp4/mov (with alpha) that could be placed like Blender plates.

licensing.notes: MIT per upstream; not audited for a pinned version (no version chosen).

security.notes: pip install and a TeX distribution when adopted.

approval_evidence: Proposed 2026-11-24 (docs/visual-engines.md) as the only credible addition for math-heavy briefs; no brief needs it yet.
